name: DevContext pre-release - engine and agent face

stages.title: W1 agent-surface trust pack (bug 5 by measurement, curated menu, partial-truth family, wire-truth gate)
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/DEEP-EVAL-2026-08-13.md section 4 W1, plus BUG-BACKLOG.md items 5, 6, 10, 9, 2. Fix bug 5 BY MEASUREMENT: the ModelContextProtocol SDK decides whether GenerateDocumentationFile or Description attributes reach the wire - verify via a real tools/list call, never assume. Re-measure the schema tax after (baseline is eval/agent-probe/results/p1.2-tool-schema-tax.md). The curated core surface candidate is PRODUCT-DIRECTION.md section 7's set plus navigation primitives. Evidence for every claim is a real MCP call showing the new response shape, not a diff. The wire-truth gate (T1.4) must be proven RED first on the pre-fix build.

stages.title: W2a one-vocabulary pack (25, 17, 7-rider invariant, 18)
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/GRAPH-DETECTION-AUDIT-2026-08-13.md section 3.3, items filed in BUG-BACKLOG.md as 25, 17, 18 plus the item-7 rider invariant. This stage exists so E1's acceptance numbers are measured in one honest currency - it lands BEFORE any edge work. Zero blast radius expected: if a matrix cell moves, stop and explain before proceeding. Re-verify every audit file:line reference before editing (house rule - the sweep was 2026-08-13).

stages.title: W2 edge completeness batch (11, 12 via TextSpan, re-measure 8, 7) + dogfood invariant
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/GRAPH-DETECTION-AUDIT-2026-08-13.md sections 3.1 and 4.1-4.2; bugs 11, 12, 8, 7 in BUG-BACKLOG.md each name their discriminating fixture - build the fixture and watch it go RED before fixing. BATCH DISCIPLINE: bug 12 moves call-edge counts on every pole by design - declare the flip/hold/not-worsen matrix cells in writing BEFORE coding, run the full matrix after, judge against the declaration. Bug 8's stated mechanism is REFUTED by 11 - re-measure before fixing. Prefer the TextSpan-on-op fix shape (record the invocation's own span on BodyOp) over patching one arm - it kills the sister sites too. Determinism seals are non-negotiable: DeterministicOrderTests stays green, call-edge canonical order stays CALL SITE.

stages.title: W5 detection declared-coverage (reachability instrument, hole closures, filed set, rung-4 jobs)
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/GRAPH-DETECTION-AUDIT-2026-08-13.md sections 8-9. The instrument comes FIRST (D1.1) and must be RED on the Orleans and TimedJob finds before any closure - it converts the hand-found holes into a permanent property, the detection twin of the dogfood invariant. Every closure follows the catalog's own add-a-shape contract and ships with a consumer-app fixture plus expectation - the missing-expectation gap is WHY these survived the 47-pole matrix. None of this touches the binder, so it is safe to deliver while E1's findings settle. Keep ArchetypeDetectorTests and the false-positive negative tests green.

stages.title: W6 metric recalibration (22, 23, 24) against the post-E1 graph
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/GRAPH-DETECTION-AUDIT-2026-08-13.md section 3.3 items 22-24 and section 10 (the G10 lesson: thresholds calibrated on a starved graph silently invert). Runs strictly AFTER E1 because two of the three thresholds read the Semantic share E1 changes. Each surviving threshold carries a comment STATING the measurement and the calibration commit. Retiring a metric that never discriminated is a valid outcome and must be recorded as one.

stages.title: W3 re-probe prep (DESIGN amendments, unseen repo) + the 10-dollar adoption gate
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: eval-results/agent-probe/RESULTS.md sections 9-10 (the pre-registered decision rules and the design debts) plus docs/dev/research/DEEP-EVAL-2026-08-13.md section 4 W3. A1.1 amends eval/agent-probe/DESIGN.md IN WRITING BEFORE any run - pre-registration is the whole point. A1.2 re-runs arm B alone on eShop, 18 runs, UNCHANGED prompt, and reports mcp_call_share against the pre-registered 0.2 floor; a result below the floor with described curated tools is a REAL finding and fires the design's honest fallback - report it as such, never as a failure of this stage. The probe batch is a long child process: run it via conductor bg start --purpose probe so the watchdog sees a live child. Budget cap per run stays at 1.50 dollars; refuse more than 60 runs.

stages.title: Close-out: README honesty pass, release-gate statuses, backlog reconciliation
stages.notes: STRAND DOC: docs/dev/research/PRE-RELEASE-PLAN-2026-08-13.md sections 6-8 plus DEEP-EVAL-2026-08-13.md section 4 (the release-gate table). The README states the agent story AS MEASURED - primer plus whatever A1.2 earned - with results linked; claims must be a subset of measurements. Reconcile BUG-BACKLOG.md (close fixed items with evidence links, re-status re-measured ones) and update the PRE-RELEASE-PLAN stage table. Leave the tree clean and pushed; merging to develop is owner-signed and NOT this stage's job.

promptExtra:
TRAPS THIS PROGRAM HAS ALREADY PAID FOR - do not rediscover them:
1. Every node scripts/... command needs an absolute cd in the SAME command - a drifted working directory has cost this program two sessions.
2. analyze takes a POSITIONAL path; query takes --path. analyze --path silently analyses the working directory instead.
3. Rebuild src/DevContext.Cli after ANY Core edit - the CLI carries its own DevContext.Core.dll (stale-dll trap). Evidence from a stale binary is worse than none.
4. CLI paths must be ABSOLUTE - a relative path is parsed as a GitHub repo and cloned.
5. MEASURE a verdict, do not read it off a doc comment. Checking what a field CONTAINS is the highest-value habit here. This audit's own file:line claims are dated 2026-08-13 - re-verify before editing.
6. Never weaken a measurement to get green: no deleted tests, no relaxed expectations, no re-declared goldens. If a bar is genuinely wrong, escalate via the tracker handoff and stop.
7. Never merge to develop. That is an owner-signed event.
8. Any batch of headless runs, matrix sweep, or judge sweep is a LONG CHILD PROCESS: run it via conductor bg start --purpose <label> -- <cmd>, then conductor bg status / bg logs. A foreground child is invisible to the watchdog and gets you killed as stalled mid-batch.
9. If eval-repos submodules are empty, run git submodule update --init first - gates and the probe need eShop present.
10. Scripts you write on Windows must be pure ASCII - PowerShell 5.1 reads unmarked UTF-8 as cp1252 and a smart dash breaks the parse; gh --jq with double quotes is mangled by PowerShell, fetch raw JSON and ConvertFrom-Json instead.

deliver.name: deliver
deliver.description: Deliver until the stage's checkpoints are confirmed. Conductor's battery is the QA; no separate verify session.
